reviewFixes.name: External recipe edits without a version increment
reviewFixes.behavior: Persist the accepted full RecipeDoc actual fields in recipes/.revision-sources, keyed by explicit case-insensitive recipe ID. Compare typed structures directly. A changed or rolled-back source at or below the previously accepted/history/retired version floor receives a new explicit version and is written back before it is exposed.
reviewFixes.durability: reload/save/save_published serialize under the same inner write lock. Atomic recipe write precedes atomic provenance write; in-memory acceptance follows successful provenance persistence. Failed provenance writes do not accept the new revision. A frozen publication can retry the same target after the failed provenance write is repaired. Persisted accepted sources also contribute the version floor across restart/deletion/recreation. The final source adds guarded rollback only for a new-ID recipe created by the failed save, allowing both save APIs to retry without reload. Existing files and external changes are retained; failed rollback is explicitly reported.
reviewFixes.notContentMatching: No content digest, fingerprint, serialization-derived identity, or image/resource matching is introduced. Stored RecipeDoc fields are the explicit actual source and are compared through structural PartialEq.

reviewFixes.name: Unknown legacy baseline must not be inferred
reviewFixes.behavior: Never derive baseRevision from an opaque legacy baseHash or candidate version minus one. A non-null old reference without an explicit valid recipe ID/version baseline is rejected for candidates, pending releases and archives. Null, empty, wrong-ID or version-zero baseline cannot bypass this rule; non-null legacy strings, numbers, booleans, arrays and objects are covered.
reviewFixes.preservation: Rejected files remain unchanged. workspace_get refuses to overwrite an existing unloaded workspace.json object, with an explicit backup/rebuild/reteach/revalidate instruction. A new candidate with no legacy reference or a null legacy reference remains readable. An exact current archive path is selected before unrelated old archives are scanned.

reviewFixes.name: Simulator contract version default
reviewFixes.behavior: recipe_contract uses recipe.get("version", 0), consistently with validation. Omitted and explicit zero versions produce the same actual contract; explicit nonzero versions remain unchanged.

migrationBoundary: When upgrading without an accepted recipe provenance file and historical version floors already occupy the on-disk version, conservatively allocate a newer version. The old history remains unchanged; the newly assigned production revision must be taught/validated/published again before use. Do not infer that the current disk recipe equals a historical snapshot.

An unprovable legacy candidate/pending/archive baseline is not automatically rebased. Preserve and back up the old candidate directory, then explicitly rebuild from the current production recipe and repeat teaching and validation.
JSON whitespace/key-order formatting alone does not allocate a new recipe version. Actual field changes, rollback, delete/recreate and restart are covered by the regression tests.

newIdRetryCorrection.behavior: For a genuinely new target ID in save or save_published, if the recipe file write succeeds but provenance persistence fails, roll back only this attempt's newly created file so the same frozen target can be retried in the same process without reload/restart.
newIdRetryCorrection.guard: Recheck that a new target does not already exist before writing. Rollback requires an ordinary non-reparse/non-symlink file whose decoded full RecipeDoc still structurally equals this attempt's document. Existing-ID files never enter the delete branch.
newIdRetryCorrection.failureBoundary: Preexisting targets are not overwritten or removed by this recovery. Externally changed content, unexpected file types, read failures and delete failures are preserved and reported together with the original provenance failure. Such a failed rollback is not reported as a successful retry recovery.
newIdRetryCorrection.testCoverage: Both public save paths use a real blocked .revision-sources temporary path and recover in-process after it is removed. Tests preserve preexisting and changed files and exercise a real Windows file handle that denies delete sharing.
